subject: MAP draft and procurement timeline - target close alignment
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: MAP draft & proposed milestones

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today — great conversation and lots of alignment on the integration and performance needs. Per our discussion, I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (FinTechCorp-MAP-v1.pdf) with suggested milestones, owners, and target dates so we have a single source of truth. High-level summary below: 

Proposed target close: 2026-03-19
Procurement / contract signature target: 2026-03-15

Key milestones (owners in parentheses):
- Technical POC kickoff (FinTech devs + Camila) — target: 2026-02-10
- SOC 2 evidence & security review (Elena / FinTech + Redwood security) — target: 2026-02-20
- SSO / SAML integration planning (Camila) — target: 2026-02-24
- Pricing & term review (Aditya + FinTech procurement) — target: 2026-03-05
- Legal review + redlines (FinTech legal + Redwood legal) — target: 2026-03-10
- Final contract sign (Procurement) — target: 2026-03-15
- Production rollout & account onboarding (Marissa) — target: 2026-03-22

Dependencies: SOC 2 evidence, timely legal turnaround, procurement PO lead time, and SSO test access.

Please review the attached MAP and let me know if the dates/owners look right from your side — happy to update. Can we lock a follow-up call for Tue 2026-02-09 to review changes and confirm the procurement timeline?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.inference.com
(650) 555-0123

Attachment: FinTechCorp-MAP-v1.pdf (PDF, 85KB)

From: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@fintechcorp.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Mark O'Neill <procurement@fintechcorp.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: MAP draft & proposed milestones

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the recap and the MAP draft. Quick notes from our side after internal sync: 

- Procurement (cc'd: Mark O'Neill) has a preferred internal signature deadline of 2026-03-12 to hit our March vendor onboarding window. Can Redwood accommodate a contract signature by 3/12 instead of 3/15?
- Legal will need the first pass of redlines by 2026-03-05; they typically take a week for standard SaaS terms.
- For the security milestone: we can complete our internal review by 2026-02-25 if Redwood provides SOC 2 artifacts and the integration security doc this week.

Ask: please include a one-page pricing summary in the MAP (we need it for procurement) and confirm SSO documentation/IdP requirements. Also, can you invite Camila and Marissa to our procurement sync next Tue (2026-02-10) at 9:30am PT?

Forwarding Mark — Mark, we expect to push legal review earlier and are hoping Redwood can meet a 3/12 signature to make vendor onboarding for our April release.

Thanks,
Elena
Director of Product | FinTech Corp
elena.garcia@fintechcorp.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.inference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.inference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference.com>, Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Feb 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: MAP draft & proposed milestones

Elena / Aditya — thanks for the notes. Quick internal alignment from the SE and Sales Ops side: 

- On the signature date: we checked with Redwood legal and sales ops. Our legal team can typically turn around standard SaaS T&Cs in ~5 business days after they receive specific redlines; earliest realistic sign date we can currently commit to is 2026-03-15, assuming legal receives redlines by 3/05. We understand your preference for 3/12 — will escalate but want to be transparent about lead times.

- SOC 2 & security artifacts: Camila will drop the SOC 2 report + integration security checklist to your team today. That should unblock your security review target of 2/25.

- SSO integration: technical kickoff for SAML can start 2026-02-10 as proposed. We estimate a 2-week window for initial test flow (depends on IdP access).

- Pricing summary: Aditya — attaching a one-page pricing summary and updating the MAP to v2 with adjusted milestone notes (see attached FinTechCorp-MAP-v2.pdf).

Proposed compromise: keep target close 2026-03-19, but set procurement signature deadline as 2026-03-15 (Redwood earliest confirmed). If FinTech procurement can approve internal PO by 3/12 we’ll prioritize resources to aim for an earlier signature, but cannot guarantee final legal sign earlier than 3/15 without redline acceleration.

Next steps:
- Camila to send SOC 2 + integration docs (today)
- Redline deadline from FinTech legal: 2026-03-05
- Procurement sync (FinTech + Redwood): 2026-02-10 9:30am PT (Elena / Mark / Camila / Marissa) — calendar invite to follow
- Follow-up alignment call: 2026-02-09 as Aditya suggested to confirm MAP updates if needed

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.inference.com

Dylan Brooks
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood.inference.com

Attachments: FinTechCorp-MAP-v2.pdf (updated MAP, 92KB); FinTechCorp-pricing-onepager.pdf (1pg, 34KB)

Subject: Re: Post-demo: MAP draft & proposed milestones

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick follow-up and updated MAP (v2).

We can work to have our legal redlines to you by 2026-03-05 and procurement will aim to have internal approval by 2026-03-12. Given Redwood's legal turnaround note, we accept the compromise of procurement signature target 2026-03-15 as the date to plan for final sign, with the objective to push earlier if possible.

Camila — please send SOC 2 artifacts and SSO checklist today as mentioned. Aditya — please send the one-page pricing summary and calendar invites for 2026-02-09 (MAP alignment) and 2026-02-10 procurement sync.

Confirmed: target close 2026-03-19; procurement signature planning target 2026-03-15 (aiming for 3/12 internal approval).

Best,
Elena
Director of Product | FinTech Corp
